implemented: Knowledge Workspace draft and published routes remain inside the shared Studio shell with the top nav and global left sidebar visible.
The sidebar includes new Skill, personal and team connections, resources, W4 knowledge-base slots, and Skill navigation.
The workshop no longer renders InvocationRail; session selection, create, refresh, status, and updated time are in the Skill conversation header.
Authoring sessions are first-class backend records scoped by tenant_id, workspace_id, draft_id, and principal idempotency scope.
Each authoring session owns isolated AutoSkill agent/session IDs and state_uri server-side; browser DTOs expose only authoring_session_id.
Session-scoped generation, message, conversation, and revision run paths bind invocations to an explicit authoring_session_id.
Concurrent invocation blocking is per authoring session, so switching sessions does not cancel or block work in another session.
Refreshing or deep-linking with sessionId restores that session's conversation, last event cursor, active invocation, and artifacts.
Composer drafts are cached per authoring_session_id while switching sessions.
The artifact pane is conditional. With no artifacts, the conversation uses a single-column layout; on narrow screens the artifact pane opens as a full-screen drawer only when artifacts exist.
